title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Mega Venusaur ex Mega Brave 003/063 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Mega Venusaur ex 003/063 Mega Brave Japanese Pokémon card is a highly sought-after collectible for Pokémon TCG fans. This double rare card features stunning artwork by illustrator 5ban Graphics, depicting the powerful Mega Venusaur ex character. Manufactured by Nintendo in 2025, this holo card is a must-have for collectors looking to add a unique and rare piece to their collection. Sourced from Japan, this card showcases the character in all its glory, making it a standout addition to any Pokémon card collection.
